issuing_body: Expert Group on How AI Principles Should be Implemented, Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI)
covered_actors: businesses using AI (BtoB and BtoC companies)
implementation_notes: Non-binding expert group report (Ver. 1.1) analyzing domestic and international AI governance trends and proposing an ideal AI governance architecture for Japan. Recommends goal-based, risk-based governance centered on legally non-binding corporate governance guidelines and international standards (e.g., ISO/IEC JTC1 SC42), concludes that legally binding horizontal AI regulation is unnecessary in Japan at this time, favors existing sector-specific frameworks for areas such as automotive and healthcare, and outlines future issues including adoption incentives (e.g., government procurement points), guidance for government AI use, international harmonization, and monitoring and civil liability.
